title: Figure 2: mass ratio vs v/c graph approaching the speed of light
description: Line graph plotting mass ratio (0–10) against v/c (0–1) on a green grid, with a red curve staying near 1 then rising sharply toward infinity as v/c approaches 1; the relativistic mass equation (1.4) appears above. Captioned "Figure 2. Mass Ratio (m/mo) Increases as Objects Approach the Speed of Light." The text concludes that present rocket technology is insufficient for spaceflight beyond near destinations.
